about: Files the package may hold without anything in it naming them (#27 AC5). scripts/build/closure.js fails the build, and npm run package, on any other file nothing names. A directory row covers only the .js and .mjs files under it. A row changes only by review, with the reason the file ships; `until` says which change removes it.

files.why: the notices of every vendored library
Valibot's license, which ships beside its build
the build's identity: buildId, outputDigest, version, commit, mode, and the protocol and schema versions
every other file's path, size, and SHA-256, which outputDigest hashes
icon artwork that ships with icons/ (scripts/build.js STATIC_DIRS); the manifest and pages use the PNGs
files.until: #27 slice 2, which stops shipping it as a declared change
